# randollm

> Real randomness for LLMs. A free, public MCP server (and REST API) that gives AI models a tool for anything random (numbers, coin flips, picks from a list, shuffles, samples, weighted choices, dice and UUIDs), because language models can't produce real randomness themselves. No sign-up or API key.

- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth): https://randollm.glauser.com/mcp
- REST API: `GET` or `POST` https://randollm.glauser.com/api/<tool>, e.g. `/api/int?min=1&max=10`
- Results come from a cryptographically secure generator; ranges use rejection sampling (unbiased). An optional `seed` makes results reproducible and marks them `"source": "seeded"`.

## Tools

- `int` (min, max): whole number, both ends inclusive
- `float` (min, max): decimal in [min, max)
- `coin`: heads or tails
- `pick` (options): one option from a list
- `sample` (items, k): k distinct items
- `shuffle` (items): random order
- `weighted` (options, weights): one option with relative weights
- `dice` (count, sides): each roll and the total
- `uuid`: random v4 UUID

## Pages

- [Home and setup](https://randollm.glauser.com/): what it is, a live demo, setup for Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor and VS Code, and the API
- [Privacy](https://randollm.glauser.com/privacy): inputs and results aren't stored; no accounts or cookies
- [Terms](https://randollm.glauser.com/terms): free to use, fair use, no warranty
- [Support](https://randollm.glauser.com/support): setup help, common problems and contact
